question: Which organisation was formed by Dr. BR Ambedkar to promote the rights of Dalits?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha** was established by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar** in **1924** in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• The primary objective of this organisation was to promote the rights and welfare of the **Dalit community**, who were historically marginalized and discriminated against in the Indian caste system.
